records.lesson: A demand, allegation, model statement or contract recital is evidence/source content; it does not silently become an established legal fact.
A proposing model answer must pass explicit review/challenge before it enters the accepted interpretation.
Test exceptions and qualifications before accepting a broad proposition.
Retain native source/evidence objects and exact source references rather than flattening away provenance.
Successful document intake does not certify the document as legally authoritative.
Unresolved semantic interpretation blocks compile handoff or requires legal review.
Clause closure alone is insufficient; document-level definitions, precedence, amendments and conflicts require reconciliation.
Legal Interrogation handoff is non-authoritative; Legal Effect compiler/certification remains the legal authority boundary.
Institutional Policy may publish/select an exact artifact and may be stricter than legal minimum, but it must not impersonate legal semantics.
Reopening an accepted interpretation invalidates dependent propositions, tests and prior handoffs.
Superseded propositions remain audit history while leaving the active compile set.
Repeated discovery over unchanged legal state must not manufacture a fresh Intention generation.
A legal-session mutation must change discovery identity and invalidate stale specialist surfaces.
A READY intention may execute only against the session revision that was actually advertised.
Hypothetical legal comparisons remain labelled analysis and cannot mint authority.
Event/effective time and evaluation time are distinct; later judgments must not rewrite what evidence/state existed historically.
Undefined normative predicates remain unresolved rather than being invented by an LLM.
Odd or absurd clause wording is preserved faithfully; validity/enforceability is a separate legal question.
Historical anecdotes are qualification material only after source/provenance is verified; plausible recollection is not enough.
Legal Interrogation may build a real LegalCompilationUnit, but only LegalRuleCompiler certification turns it into a publication-eligible legal generation.
A source identity asserting VERIFIED without verifier-issued evidence remains unverified and must be rejected.
Every compiled provision reference preserves the source identity expressionId; the clause id remains the provisionId and must not replace expression identity.
The compiler bridge never converts explanatory strings into LegalPredicate conditions or exceptions; structured predicates must be established before compilation.

provenance.claim: Legal Effect v0.14 owns structured legal-effect evaluation and the compiler/certification authority boundary; public legal API remains legal.effect/0.10.
Intention Service dev11 owns CLARIFY/CONFIRM/READY resolution, discovery-provider refresh/replacement semantics and discovery-generation stamping.
Institutional Policy owns fixed/versioned publication identity, authority, effective time, lifecycle, topology, rollout and replay rather than domain legal semantics.
Legal Interrogation dev5 implements clause interrogation, proposition challenge, lifecycle invalidation and a real Intention Service dev11 discovery adapter.
